resolvedBranches.boundary: Resolution means the handoff contract received a matching executed, provenance-bearing return. One provenance+material evidence payload may resolve only one branch across the accumulated VAJRA result history, preventing replay amplification across branches and repeated applications. It does not mean VAJRA semantically verified the returned material or proved the target claim.
